channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Dow Jones Industrial Average round-trips between Ottawa and the Treasury
item.description: The Dow Jones Industrial Average has built a 300-point advance and handed every point of it back inside a single vertical break, and it trades just beneath 53,500 for a gain of roughly a tenth of a percent. The session range runs better than 320 points against a net of 67.

item.title: United Kingdom: Resilient growth versus fiscal strain – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank's Senior FX Strategist Jane Foley highlights that recent UK data, including Q2 Gross Domestic Product (GDP), real output per head and the August composite Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI), point to resilient growth and improved consumer confidence.

item.title: Canadian Dollar faces double trouble from Oil slump, US tariffs
item.description: USD/CAD trades around 1.3835 on Tuesday at the time of writing, down a modest 0.07% on the day. The pair lacks a clear direction as both the US Dollar (USD) and the Canadian Dollar (CAD) face headwinds.

item.title: Germany: Business climate brightens – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Dr. Ralph Solveen notes that the German Ifo Business Climate Index rose from 86.7 to 88.8 in August, with both current conditions and expectations improving. He highlights stronger foreign demand, rising government spending and better sentiment as factors supporting growth.

item.title: British Pound holds near six-month high as Hormuz hopes lift sentiment
item.description: The Pound Sterling (GBP) consolidates near a six-month high of 1.3675 on Tuesday as Middle East headlines improve risk appetite, while investors await the release of key US economic data and the speech by Federal Reserve (Fed) Chair Kevin Warsh at Jackson Hole.

item.title: Eurozone: AfD surge raises policy uncertainty – ING
item.description: Carsten Brzeski of ING underscores that the AfD’s rise to Germany’s largest party in polls introduces significant uncertainty for Eurozone policy.

item.title: Australian Dollar up modestly on RBA, weak USD
item.description: AUD/USD steadies around the mid 0.7100s at the time of writing on Tuesday, clawing back most of the previous day's modest losses.

item.title: British Pound: Range-bound against US Dollar ahead of Budget – Scotiabank
item.description: Scotiabank strategists Shaun Osborne and Eric Theoret highlight GBP/USD consolidating in a tight mid-1.36 range as a quiet data and Bank of England (BoE) calendar contrasts with softer yield spreads, which have eroded some fundamental support.

item.title: US President Trump: US Navy has cleared Strait of Hormuz mines
item.description: United States (US) President Donald Trump said the US Navy has cleared the Strait of Hormuz of mines, removing one of the supply risks that has kept the Oil market on edge.

item.title: Gold takes a breather after climbing to a fresh three-month high, US PCE in focus
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) remains under pressure on Tuesday after setting a fresh three-month high of $4,697 earlier in the day. Traders appear to be booking some profits following the recent rally, which has pushed the Relative Strength Index (RSI) into overbought territory.

item.title: Canada: Investment risk and USMCA reliability – Societe Generale
item.description: Dev Ashish at Societe Generale highlights that the Trump administration’s threatened 50% tariff on Canadian vehicles and parts signals a broader push to redirect manufacturing investment to the US, challenging USMCA reliability.

item.title: WTI slides as traders shrug off US sanctions on Iran, Hormuz risks persist
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) Oil edges lower on Tuesday, extending its decline for a second straight day as traders look past Washington’s latest economic pressure on Iran.

item.title: Mexican Peso: Carry appeal faces crowding risk – MUFG
item.description: MUFG analysts Derek Halpenny and Abdul-Ahad Lockhart state that the Mexican Peso continues to benefit from low FX volatility and strong carry demand, with USD/MXN breaking below 17.00 for the first time since June 2024.

item.title: Japanese Yen: BoJ September risk looms in flat range against US Dollar – Scotiabank
item.description: Scotiabank strategists Shaun Osborne and Eric Theoret note USD/JPY trading in a relatively flat range between 158.00 and the mid-159s as the Japanese Yen (JPY) underperforms most G10 currencies.

item.title: US Dollar: Credibility risks for USD – TD Securities
item.description: TD Securities argues that Jackson Hole is more about Federal Reserve (Fed) credibility than new guidance for the US Dollar (USD). They see rate expectations staying anchored, but warn that any failure by Chair Warsh to reaffirm the inflation mandate could weigh on USD.

item.title: Silver retreats ahead of US PCE data, but underlying support persists
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) extends its decline on Tuesday and trades around $67.50 at the time of writing, down 1.43% on the day.

item.title: Euro: Upside limited above fair value against US Dollar – Scotiabank
item.description: Scotiabank strategists Shaun Osborne and Eric Theoret report EUR/USD consolidating in the mid to upper 1.16s after stronger German IFO and Gross Domestic Product (GDP) data, which should bolster European Central Bank (ECB) confidence ahead of the September 10 meeting.

item.title: US CB Consumer Confidence Index eases to 89.4 in August
item.description: US consumer sentiment loses some momentum in August, as the Conference Board’s Consumer Confidence Index recedes to 89.4 from July’s 90.2 (revised from 90.8).

item.title: Gold: Overbought rally eyes key resistance – UOB
item.description: UOB’s Quek Ser Leang notes that Spot Gold remains in a broader uptrend after breaking above a key declining trendline and reaching an intraday high near $4,700.

item.title: Copper: Supply setbacks push market into deficit – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Barbara Lambrecht notes Copper prices are rising again as ICSG data show a significant June deficit and a sharply reduced year‑to‑date surplus.

item.title: Euro stays near three-month high as US Dollar remains subdued
item.description: EUR/USD holds modest gains on Tuesday as the latest Middle East developments fail to trigger a strong market reaction, while the US Dollar (USD) struggles to recover from last week’s sell-off sparked by the US Treasury’s decision to increase buybacks of longer-dated government securities.

item.title: Canadian Dollar: Trading near fair value against US Dollar - Scotiabank
item.description: Scotiabank strategists Shaun Osborne and Eric Theoret describe USD/CAD trading close to their fair value estimate around 1.3842 as the Canadian Dollar (CAD) reacts to trade headlines and weaker Oil prices.

item.title: US Dollar: Bond market supports cautious consolidation – ING
item.description: ING’s Francesco Pesole notes the Dollar is drawing support from the US bond market as long-dated yields stabilise, while US-Canada trade tensions and Iran-related sanctions risks complicate the outlook.

item.title: Gold: Tariff conflict fuels safe haven bid – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Carsten Fritsch reports that Gold has surged to a three‑month high near USD 4,700 per ounce as US–Canada tariff tensions escalate and concerns over US debt intensify. Silver and Platinum have also rallied.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar defies stronger US Dollar as RBNZ rate hike bets offer support
item.description: NZD/USD edges slightly higher on Tuesday and trades around 0.5965 at the time of writing, up 0.08% on the day.

item.title: Australian Dollar: RBA risks and carry support – BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad notes the Australian Dollar (AUD) largely ignored the Reserve Bank of Australia's (RBA) August Minutes, which reiterated Governor Michele Bullock’s warning that another rate hike is quite possible.

item.title: British Pound: Range trading outlook against Euro – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank's Senior FX Strategist Jane Foley discusses the British Pound's (GBP) recent performance, noting it is currently the top G10 currency on a 1‑day view but only middling over longer horizons.

item.title: US ADP Employment Change 4-week average increases to 11.750K
item.description: Private-sector hiring in the US has gained some pace in early August. According to the NER Pulse, the weekly companion to the ADP National Employment Report, companies added an average of 11.750K jobs per week in the four weeks ending August 8.

item.title: US Dollar: Fragmentation risks and reserve diversification – MUFG
item.description: Michael Wan at MUFG discusses US threats of economic punishment on countries dealing with Iran and new sanctions on over 60 entities.

item.title: GBP/JPY Price Forecast: Bulls recover lost ground as intervention effect wears off
item.description: GBP/JPY extends its steady recovery on Tuesday and has now recouped almost all the losses triggered by the joint US-Japan intervention in late July. The intervention was aimed at curbing excessive weakness in the Japanese Yen (JPY) after USD/JPY climbed above 160 to a forty-year high.
